column1: # Black/Matrix AD - Chapter 4: The Pope's World Choice
# No manual wrapping: patchline.py supplies pixel-aware line breaks.

column2: What!!
At last, you have appeared!!
You who destroyed us $$羽$$less people in the Great Flood...
you hateful fragments of $$大悪神ゴッド$$!!
W-what are you talking about all of a sudden?!
Through Lord $$メフィスト$$'s power, I was cursed with immortality...
After Lady $$リリス$$ passed, I became his wife to bring forth humankind...
I am the one called the $$黒き聖母$$...
And... I escaped that Great Flood long ago aboard the ark...
I am also the last survivor of the $$羽$$less people...
$$ノア$$'s daughter, $$ヤペテ$$!!
No... Even the $$教皇$$...
was a survivor of the talking $$オサル$$s!?
Was this $$世界$$ truly so evil...
that this $$世界$$ had to be completely destroyed...!?
That certain rich people prey on the poor and those living in less fortunate regions...
is nothing that began only now...
Even if we perish today, and even if three thousand years have passed...
the wealthy in a mere handful of rich regions will likely...
prey on people starving or suffering through war while feigning ignorance...
and force terrible conditions upon the $$弱者$$...
It is easy enough to imagine!!
Th-that is not true!
Is it really!?
Furthermore, many black-$$羽$$ed people in this $$世界$$...
live with the fear that the $$約束の地$$ in the sky...
could fall upon them at any moment, bringing the destruction of humankind...
Yet each day, they live as though they do not notice it!?
Even now, it is not too late!
If you $$神の子羊$$s who wear the armor die,
and the $$大邪神$$ armor is $$封印$$ed once more...
stability will return to this $$世界$$, even if it remains evil...!!
You must immediately...
kill yourselves!!
If that is too cruel for you...
I shall lend you a hand personally.
Or... will you, heir to Lord $$メフィスト$$'s soul...
bring this to an end by your own hand!?
Not everyone in this $$世界$$ is evil...
There were people who wanted to live in harmony too!!
Damn... what should we do?!
Well... I shall give you time to think...
After all, unless this child wears the armor of the $$大邪神$$...
there can be no further change to this $$世界$$...
